Coram : R.F. NARIMAN*, V. RAMASUBRAMANIAN
Recovery of Debts and Bankruptcy Act, 1993 – ss. 19, 20, 21 and 22 – Debts Recovery Tribunal (Procedure) Rules, 1993 – r.5A – Application for review – Appellant-Bank filed an application u/s. 19 of the RDB Act for recovery of a sum of Rs.191,03,54,070.96/- – An stating that given the admissions contained in the balance of the relevant years of the respondent- Company, a sum of Rs. 222,51,00,000/- was owed by the respondent – The said I.A. was allowed by DRT – The respondent filed an appeal against the said order before the DRAT –
